description: Department of Local Government Eastern Province - Elect the New Vice Chairman of Koralaipatty west Pradeshiya Sabha Batticaloa Districy will not take Place due to the Covid-19
reasoning: This gazette content specifically concerns the summoning and cancellation of a meeting to elect a Vice Chairman for a local authority (Koralaipattu West Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. This falls directly under electoral processes at the local government level, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
